title: ArcheType Computation Definition Contract
summary: Attach side-effect-free structural computation graphs and triggers to ArcheType definitions; free-form executable code is excluded.

criteria: The declaration shape is human-approved before implementation: a derived field is defined by a computation graph plus exactly one trigger drawn from write, query or batch.
The computation graph is a structural expression tree over declared fields and constants; it is side-effect-free and pure, and free-form executable code is excluded by construction.
Evaluation is deterministic: the same inputs at the same schema version always yield the same derived value, so a dry run and a stored value can be compared.
Profile coverage is declared for pricing, tax, BOM, payroll and forecast derivations without turning any of them into a business-specific model.
The exclusion set is explicit: evaluation scheduling, caching and invalidation belong to the computation runtime, and this contract only declares what must be computed.

risks.desc: Admitting free-form executable code into a computation definition would turn ArcheType metadata into a remote-code-execution surface reachable by any definition author.
risks.mitigation: Restrict the contract to a structural expression graph over declared fields, reject script or eval-style bodies at declaration time and prove the rejection with negatives.

risks.desc: A wrong derived value in a pricing, tax, BOM or payroll graph is a financial-correctness incident rather than a display defect, and it can propagate silently to downstream records.
risks.mitigation: Require deterministic evaluation, defer money rounding to the field type contract and demand reproducible dry-run evidence before any human-approved activation.

risks.desc: A graph that writes, calls out or reads another tenant's inputs would break auditability and could leak data across a tenant boundary through a derived field.
risks.mitigation: Enforce side-effect-free purity and tenant-scoped inputs as declaration-time rules, with cross-tenant and write-attempt negatives as a fixed test axis.

risks.desc: A computation definition contract could be misread as authority over the computation runtime, the schema engine or a business-specific pricing model.
risks.mitigation: Keep the computation runtime, schema engine and business-model exclusions explicit in every phase, and preserve NO-GO without new human authority.

featureDefs.title: Özellik Tanımları
items: The declared shape is a derived field bound to one computation graph and exactly one trigger drawn from write, query or batch.
Girdi is the set of declared fields and constants visible in the owning ArcheType; çıktı is a single deterministic derived value plus its evaluation provenance.
The graph is a structural expression tree that stays side-effect-free and pure, so free-form executable code is excluded and no script host is introduced.
The same vocabulary covers pricing, tax, BOM, payroll and forecast derivations, which keeps five business needs on one contract rather than five engines.
Kapsam sınırı gereği evaluation scheduling, caching and invalidation belong to the computation runtime; this node declares what to compute, not when.
featureDefs.notes: archetype-computation-contract/featureDefs: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
featureDefs.prompt: ArcheType Computation Definition Contract featureDefs kapsamı. Kapsa: derived field plus graph plus single trigger, declared-field inputs, pure structural expression tree, shared pricing/tax/BOM/payroll/forecast vocabulary. Exclude free-form executable code and the computation runtime. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

security.title: Güvenlik Önlemleri
items: Excluding free-form executable code is the primary control: a structural expression graph is not a script host, so a definition author cannot obtain code execution through ArcheType metadata.
Purity is enforced rather than assumed under least privilege: a graph that attempts a write, an outbound call or an ambient read is refused, which keeps evaluation auditable.
Every graph is tenant scoped, so a derived field may read only inputs inside its own tenant; a cross-tenant reference is refused instead of silently filtered, which preserves izolasyon.
Triggers on write, query and batch are the untrusted entry points and each needs its own erişim decision plus an append-only denetim record before any implementation.

codeOptimization.title: Kod Optimizasyonu
items: The planned handoff keeps one typed graph model and one validator katman instead of a per-profile evaluator, so pricing and payroll share the same code path.
Graph validation, cycle detection and bound checking stay pure functions with low cyclomatic complexity, which makes a definition testable without an evaluator.
Declaration and evaluation stay in separate layers; ölü kod and speculative per-domain abstractions are refused, and engineering rules are reached through standardRefs rather than restated here.
codeOptimization.notes: archetype-computation-contract/codeOptimization: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
codeOptimization.prompt: ArcheType Computation Definition Contract codeOptimization kapsamı. Kapsa: single typed graph model, pure validation and cycle detection, declaration/evaluation layer split, referenced standards. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

securityOptimization.title: Güvenlik Optimizasyonu
items: The allowlist of expression node kinds is closed: only declared operators and declared field references are admissible, and anything outside it is refused before storage.
Least ayrıcalık applies to triggers: a batch trigger cannot acquire a wider input scope than the write trigger on the same derived field.
Declared depth, node-count and evaluation-cost limits harden the surface against a definition crafted to exhaust platform resources, and rate-limits apply per tenant.
A stored definition is integrity-protected and versioned, so an unreviewed edit cannot silently change a money-bearing derivation.
securityOptimization.notes: archetype-computation-contract/securityOptimization: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
securityOptimization.prompt: ArcheType Computation Definition Contract securityOptimization kapsamı. Kapsa: closed operator allowlist, least-privilege triggers, declared cost bounds with per-tenant rate limits, versioned integrity-protected definitions. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

performance.title: Performans Optimizasyonu
items: A p95 budget is declared for evaluating a single derived field on a write trigger over a realistic definition, and a separate budget applies to a batch trigger; no measurement is claimed here.
Input resolution for a graph must avoid N+1 lookups: the declared field set is fetched once per evaluation rather than per expression node.
A query trigger may use a bounded cache keyed by tenant and schema version, and cache invalidation remains the computation runtime's responsibility rather than this contract's.
performance.notes: archetype-computation-contract/performance: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
performance.prompt: ArcheType Computation Definition Contract performance kapsamı. Kapsa: per-trigger p95 budgets, N+1-free input resolution, bounded query cache with runtime-owned invalidation. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

mobileApps.title: Mobil Uygulama Uyumu
items: Mobil, web and service channels read the same derived field value; a cihaz may not evaluate a graph locally and submit its own result as authoritative.
An offline client shows the last synchronised derived value as stale rather than recomputing it, because determinism is guaranteed only against a known schema version.
No mobile calculation UI is introduced here; presenting a derived value and its provenance stays a separate consumer responsibility.
mobileApps.notes: archetype-computation-contract/mobileApps: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
mobileApps.prompt: ArcheType Computation Definition Contract mobileApps kapsamı. Kapsa: server-authoritative derived values across channels, offline staleness rather than local recomputation, no calculation UI here. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

wcag.title: WCAG 2.2 AAA
items: Any future definition editor must expose the expression graph as keyboard navigable structure with a visible odak ring at the AAA kontrast threshold, not as a drag-only canvas.
A validation refusal must be announced through an aria live region with the offending node named, so a screen reader user can locate the rejected expression.
This contract defines declaration semantics only, so no accessibility conformance may be recorded here and every such result stays planned.
wcag.notes: archetype-computation-contract/wcag: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
wcag.prompt: ArcheType Computation Definition Contract wcag kapsamı. Kapsa: keyboard-navigable graph structure, announced validation refusals, semantics-only scope. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

deployment.title: Dağıtım (Swarm/K8s/Shared)
items: This shard performs no release or deploy; any future Kubernetes topology for an evaluator or a batch worker remains human-developer work.
Activating a new computation definition is a config-level change behind human approval, so it must not require a container rebuild or a code deploy.
Withdrawing this shard affects only the planning contract and its deterministic projections, so rollback is bounded, runtimeDataImpact remains none and NO-GO stands.
deployment.notes: archetype-computation-contract/deployment: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
deployment.prompt: ArcheType Computation Definition Contract deployment kapsamı. Kapsa: no release or deploy here, definition activation as an approved config change, bounded withdrawal. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

eca.title: ECA Kuralları
items: A write trigger is an olay binding rather than an automation: it says when a derived field must be recomputed, and it may not itself perform another business action.
A recomputation chain stops at maxChainDepth 6, so one derived field feeding another cannot produce an unbounded cascade.
Repeating the same trigger for the same input version must be idempotent, and activating a new definition always requires an explicit onay step.
eca.notes: archetype-computation-contract/eca: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
eca.prompt: ArcheType Computation Definition Contract eca kapsamı. Kapsa: triggers as recomputation bindings, depth-bounded cascades, idempotent replay and approval-gated activation. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

aiAgents.title: AI Ajan Davranışı
items: AI may read this contract and suggest a changeset, but generating or updating an app or module, overriding a ruleset and writing directly to production are forbidden actions ve yasak kalır.
AI cannot activate, edit or execute a computation definition; every such apply step needs insan onayı, and a money-bearing derivation additionally requires a step-up review.
sub_prompt is treated as untrusted input, the kill switch stays available, and no prompt or repository text may widen this shard's fixed D01 scope or fabricate executed-test evidence.
aiAgents.notes: archetype-computation-contract/aiAgents: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
aiAgents.prompt: ArcheType Computation Definition Contract aiAgents kapsamı. Kapsa: read and suggest-changeset only, forbidden app/module mutation, human-approved definition activation with step-up on money derivations, untrusted sub_prompt and kill switch. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

testing.title: Testler & QA
items: Planned positive cases cover a write, query and batch trigger over the same graph producing identical derived values, as unit and integration matrices.
Planned negatives prove free-form executable code, an outbound call and a write attempt inside a graph are each rejected at declaration time.
Planned negatives prove a cross-tenant input reference, a cycle between two derived fields and a graph beyond the declared depth or node-count bound are refused.
Planned determinism cases replay a pricing, tax, BOM, payroll and forecast derivation against a fixed schema version and compare the result as reproducible evidence.
No result may be recorded before a real human-approved run exists; a planned matrix is never counted as a passing test.
testing.notes: archetype-computation-contract/testing: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
testing.prompt: ArcheType Computation Definition Contract testing kapsamı. Kapsa: trigger-parity positives, declaration-time rejection negatives, cross-tenant and cycle negatives, determinism replay evidence. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

owasp.title: OWASP & Standartlar
items: OWASP A03 injection is modeled by excluding free-form executable code and admitting only a closed operator set, with strict doğrulama of every expression node before storage.
OWASP A01 broken access control is modeled through tenant-scoped graph inputs and an explicit authorization requirement on each write, query and batch trigger.
OWASP A04 insecure design is modeled by declaring purity, determinism and cost bounds up front, so an expensive or impure definition cannot become a denial-of-service vector.
owasp.notes: archetype-computation-contract/owasp: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
owasp.prompt: ArcheType Computation Definition Contract owasp kapsamı. Kapsa: A03 via closed operator set and validation, A01 via tenant-scoped inputs and trigger authorization, A04 via purity and cost bounds. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

integration.title: Kernel/Core Entegrasyonu
items: Kernel integration is contributor -> app-kernel/k-archetype-computation with contributionKind specification, targetProviderIds [k-computation] and runtimeProviderClaimAllowed=false.
All three publicBoundary flags stay false, so a computation definition touches no kernel internal, no kernel database and no cross-context write path; a recomputation need travels as an olay instead.
This schedule is only a planning window from 2026-07-01 to 2028-06-09; predecessor schema-metadata-engine-contract ends 2028-03-15, so no executable-order or readiness claim is allowed.
dependsOn stays exactly schema-metadata-engine-contract and archetype-field-type-contract, and the parent-only k-schema bağımlılık edge is not inherited.
Scope stays inside the declaration layer: the computation runtime owns evaluation, the schema engine owns definitions and no business-specific model is introduced.
integration.notes: archetype-computation-contract/integration: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
integration.prompt: ArcheType Computation Definition Contract integration kapsamı. Kapsa: contributor routing under areaId k-archetype-computation to k-computation, closed public boundary, exact dependsOn, planning window marker and the fixed exclusion set. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

moduleUsage.title: Modül Kullanımı
items: A consuming module declares a derived field through this contract and tüketir the resulting value; it may not compute the same value locally and write it back as authoritative.
A consumer must reach inputs through the declared field set rather than a doğrudan tablo read, so the graph stays the single description of the derivation.
Scheduling and caching a derivation belong to the computation runtime; this contract declares the derivation, it does not execute it.
moduleUsage.notes: archetype-computation-contract/moduleUsage: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
moduleUsage.prompt: ArcheType Computation Definition Contract moduleUsage kapsamı. Kapsa: declared-derivation consumption, no local recomputation or direct table reads, excluded scheduling and caching authority. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

dataLifecycle.title: Veri Yaşam Döngüsü & Uyum
items: A derived field may expose PII indirectly, for example a payroll figure computed from personal inputs, so KVKK/GDPR veri sınıflandırması, purpose, owner and retention approval are required before implementation; DSAR silme veya anonimleştirme yolu istenir.
A derived value inherits the saklama süresi of its most restrictive input, and erasing a source input must invalidate or anonymise any materialised derived value that depends on it.
Definition versions are kept append-only so a historical money figure stays explainable, and any change to a stored derivation follows an expand-contract migration rather than an in-place rewrite.
dataLifecycle.notes: archetype-computation-contract/dataLifecycle: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
dataLifecycle.prompt: ArcheType Computation Definition Contract dataLifecycle kapsamı. Kapsa: indirect PII in derived values, retention inherited from inputs with erasure propagation, append-only definition versions and expand-contract evolution. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

observability.title: Gözlemlenebilirlik & Operasyon
items: Planned SLI/SLO metrics include evaluation latency percentiles by trigger kind, declaration-time rejection counts by rule and the share of evaluations that hit a declared cost bound, on tenant-safe labels.
Structured log and trace records carry the definition id, its version and the trigger kind; input values and derived money figures are redacted and never become metric labels.

Alerts cover a determinism mismatch between a dry run and a stored value, a rejection-rate spike after a definition change and repeated cost-bound breaches; thresholds and the runbook require human approval.
observability.notes: archetype-computation-contract/observability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
observability.prompt: ArcheType Computation Definition Contract observability kapsamı. Kapsa: per-trigger evaluation SLIs, redacted definition-scoped traces, determinism-mismatch and cost-bound alerts with a human-approved runbook. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

reliability.title: Dayanıklılık & Süreklilik
items: The primary failure mode is an unresolvable input or a bound breach during evaluation; it degrades to an explicit refusal with the prior derived value left intact, never to a silent partial result.
Recomputation is idempotent by construction: the same inputs at the same definition version yield the same derived value, so a retry with bounded backoff cannot drift the result.
A batch trigger that fails repeatedly is routed to the owning runtime's dead-letter path rather than retried forever, and no derived value is persisted from a partially evaluated graph.
reliability.notes: archetype-computation-contract/reliability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
reliability.prompt: ArcheType Computation Definition Contract reliability kapsamı. Kapsa: explicit refusal on unresolvable input or bound breach, idempotent recomputation with bounded retry, dead-letter routing for failing batches. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.
